title: Where and when: postpositions
summary: Say where things are with place nouns (*masanın üstünde*, *bankanın karşısında*), use the postpositions that take no case, the dative and the ablative (*senin için*, *bana göre*, *yemekten sonra*), and say how long something has lasted: *Üç yıldır Türkçe öğreniyorum*, *2020'den beri*.
canDo: Say where things and people are: on, under, in front of, behind, next to, between, opposite
Ask for and give directions in town
Say before, after, since and because of
Say how long you have been doing something
